description: Implementation of internal cryptographic functions for Abseil's random number generator, including AES-based round functions, block shuffling, and permutation routines.

classes.name: Vector128
classes.description: Software implementation of a 128-bit vector register using four uint32_t elements.

methods.name: Vector128Load
methods.description: Loads 16 bytes from memory into a Vector128 object.

methods.name: Vector128Store
methods.description: Stores a Vector128 object into memory.

methods.name: AesRound
methods.description: Performs one AES round on a Vector128 state with a given round key.

methods.name: BlockShuffle
methods.description: Performs a fixed shuffle of 16 blocks in the state array.

methods.name: FeistelRound
methods.description: Executes one round of the Feistel network using AES subrounds.

methods.name: Permute
methods.description: Applies multiple Feistel rounds and block shuffles to permute the state.

methods.name: SwapEndian
methods.description: Pre-swaps byte order of the state for big-endian architectures.

methods.name: GetKeys
methods.description: Retrieves round keys for the cryptographic permutation.

methods.name: Absorb
methods.description: Absorbs seed data into the internal state.

methods.name: Generate
methods.description: Generates new random data by permuting the internal state with backtracking resistance.
